semantic_audit.assessment: Three hard-field mask locations are reconciled before scoring; status conflicts and norm-different resolved values fail. Formats aliases use a weaker equivalence than actual scoring (finding MASK-02). An explicit null expected_hard_field_masks entry is silently treated as absent (finding MASK-04).

UNRESOLVED hard fields are excluded and may not carry resolved_value. APPLICABLE_ABSENCE is scored against list [], boolean exclusivity False, or scalar None, independently of expected execution. Missing masks become N/A. Non-hard mask validation is incomplete (finding MASK-03).
Hard-field partial masks are restricted to LISTS and list-valued resolved/hard gold; list subset comparison is used. Scalar sort masks evade that restriction (finding MASK-03).

Adapter always compares expected_execution, including blocked gold, and does not suppress applicable operand assertions merely because gold is blocked. Imported summarize nevertheless conditions blocked-gold false-execution eligibility on valid_output (finding MASK-05).

Scoring calls the established helper only on formats; exclusive_formats and excluded_formats do not receive BOTH expansion. Resolved formats values receive the same helper. Alias conflict checks omit this normalization (finding MASK-02).

Structured expected_semantic_remainder is excluded instead of equated to semantic_text, and structured advisory accuracy is explicitly N/A. Literal string semantics alone are scored. Falsy actual semantic_text values are coerced to empty string; the review does not infer a broader native representation equivalence.
All imported OPERANDS can be asserted, but all *_exclusive mismatches are explicitly omitted from the critical list (finding MASK-01).

findings.title: Executed numeric exclusivity mismatches are omitted from critical fidelity
findings.evidence: The critical list filters out every operand whose name ends with _exclusive, although OPERANDS includes rating_min_exclusive, rating_max_exclusive, year_min_exclusive, and year_max_exclusive.
findings.static_witness: With actual execution True, an applicable rating_min_exclusive=True oracle and actual False create an assertion mismatch but no critical_executed_operand_mismatches entry for that field.
findings.impact: An executed changed boundary can disappear from mandatory critical operand fidelity.
findings.recommended_change: Include all applicable mismatched OPERANDS, including exclusivity flags, in critical executed operand mismatches; add regression coverage for both inclusive-to-exclusive and exclusive-to-inclusive changes.

findings.title: Equivalent formats aliases are rejected before allowed BOTH normalization
findings.evidence: mask_for uses norm alone to reconcile resolved values, while score normalizes resolved formats via normalize_both.
findings.static_witness: Same-status aliases with resolved_value [BOTH] versus [ONLINE, PHYSICAL] raise conflicting resolved values even though the scorer treats those formats values as equivalent.
findings.impact: Independently equivalent namespace oracles are incorrectly rejected by pre-scoring gold validation.
findings.recommended_change: For field formats only, apply the same established normalize_both plus norm equivalence when reconciling resolved aliases; preserve literal comparisons for exclusive_formats/excluded_formats.

findings.title: Scalar sort can carry PARTIALLY_APPLICABLE without rejection
findings.evidence: check_gold validates masks only for OPERANDS. sort is outside OPERANDS, and its score branch accepts every APPLICABLE status, including PARTIALLY_APPLICABLE.
findings.static_witness: expected_sort=TITLE and metric_applicability.sort.status=PARTIALLY_APPLICABLE pass the shown gold checks and are scored as a scalar full comparison.
findings.impact: The frozen list-only partial-applicability contract is not enforced on all scored mask fields.
findings.recommended_change: Validate semantic_remainder and sort masks explicitly; reject PARTIALLY_APPLICABLE for scalar sort and other scalar-only oracle fields before scoring.

findings.title: Explicit null in one mask namespace is silently ignored
findings.evidence: expected_hard_field_masks.get(field) is appended only if non-None, whereas present null aliases in metric_applicability reach validation and fail.
findings.static_witness: A valid applicable subjects alias in metric_applicability plus expected_hard_field_masks.subjects=null is accepted with the null alias ignored. With only that null alias it becomes unreviewed N/A.
findings.impact: A present malformed alias is conflated with absence, and validation depends on namespace.
findings.recommended_change: Use key membership to distinguish absent fields from present null/invalid mask objects and validate every present alias uniformly.

findings.title: False-execution summary eligibility excludes invalid outputs with execution True
findings.evidence: summarize first selects valid outputs, then defines blocked negatives and false executions only within that valid subset. Adapter execution_allowed mismatch remains unconditional.
findings.static_witness: Blocked gold paired with execution=True but an unrecognized typed decision or empty actual_plan is invalid_output and an execution mismatch, but contributes neither false_execution_count nor the blocked denominator in the imported summary.
findings.impact: Strict blocked gold is not always applicable to the summarized execution safety measure; malformed executed outputs can be omitted from both numerator and denominator.
findings.recommended_change: Keep typed/schema validity reporting separate from execution applicability. Include all gold-applicable blocked rows in the execution denominator and count explicit execution=True as false execution regardless of schema/typed validity.

test_coverage_observations: Existing tests statically cover prefixed partial masks, unresolved versus absence fields, negative absence mismatch, conflicting status aliases, and formats-only BOTH normalization.

No existing test covers numeric exclusivity critical omission, equivalent formats aliases, scalar sort partial masks, explicit null expected_hard_field_masks aliases, or invalid-output blocked execution summary eligibility.
